repos_data.description: Off Grid AI — private, on-device AI. Run open models (text, vision, image, voice) locally through one OpenAI-compatible gateway. No cloud, no accounts, no API keys.
Production ready toolkit to run AI locally
Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models. Supports GGUF, MLX, Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, FLUX and more.

The Swiss Army Knife of Offline AI. Chat, see, speak, and generate images on your phone or Mac — GGUF LLMs, vision, Whisper speech-to-text, Stable Diffusion, tool calling, and local-network servers. Runs on your CPU, GPU, or NPU. No account, no API key, zero data leaves your device.

Kubernetes operator for self-hosted LLM inference across a heterogeneous GPU fleet: NVIDIA CUDA, AMD Vulkan, and Apple Silicon Metal. Runtimes: llama.cpp, vLLM, TGI, mlx-server. Multi-GPU sharding, model caching, OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Apache-2.0, run across homelab and on-prem fleets, actively developed.
Analyze your realtime streaming data with LLM

A Go toolkit for building AI agents and applications across multiple providers. Unified LLM client, agent framework with handoffs, tool calling, streaming, structured output, MCP integration, and cost tracking.
OpenAPI linting, diffing and testing. Optic helps prevent breaking changes, publish accurate documentation and improve the design of your APIs.
Orchestration of autonomous, collaborative AI agents in Go — an idiomatic Go port of CrewAI.
Plugin for JADX to integrate MCP server

repo_meta_data.description: LocalAI is the open-source AI engine. Run any model - LLMs, vision, voice, image, video - on any hardware. No GPU required.
